sources.name: timnath.org
sources.notes: Checked 4 October 2026: a WordPress site whose events page redirects to sponsorships; the news RSS carries no events. Meetings and festivals are read from its pages by hand. Checked again 10 November 2026 for a feed: still none. /events/?ical=1 answers 410, /wp-json/tribe/events/v1/events and /events/feed/ 404. /community-events/ (200) names the Town's events (Holiday Festival, Town Clean Up Days, 4th of July Celebration, Council Chats, Touch a Truck, Movie Night, Project Fair, Ice Cream Social, Fall Festival) and links the year's schedule, without a calendar. Meetings are published through CivicWeb (timnath.civicweb.net, embedded on /agendas-minutes/) and recreation programs through RecDesk (timnath.recdesk.com); both are proposed as their own entries. robots.txt asks for a 30-second crawl delay and disallows nothing.

sources.name: Timnath Chamber of Commerce
sources.lastNote: No feed found: /rss.xml, /feed.xml, /events.ics and /calendar.ics answer 404; the events page is drawn in the browser. 10 November 2026.
sources.notes: Found and read 10 November 2026. The chamber's site is a single-page app: every path returns the same shell and the events list is drawn by script, so nothing could be counted from here. Its sitemap (303 URLs) carries 56 under /events, among them Timnath Connect (monthly), Taste of Timnath 2026, Towns Connecting Over Coffee - Timnath (February 2027), Caffeinate & Collaborate, and a number of Severance and Fort Collins events (Severance Small Business Meetup, Fritzler Farm Park), so it needs reading for which are in Timnath. Each event page offers a single-event .ics download made in the browser; there is no calendar-wide feed (the app's bundle names none), and /rss is a page, not a feed. The chamber also has an Eventbrite organizer page (eventbrite.com/o/109326387961, from search results, not fetched). robots.txt: 'Allow: /' for unnamed agents with a content signal of search=yes, ai-train=no; named AI crawlers are disallowed. A page for a person, in a browser. Checked again 10 November 2026: the robots.txt names ClaudeBot, anthropic-ai and Claude-Web with 'Disallow: /', so the site was not crawled further (its robots.txt and sitemap.xml were fetched in one step before that rule was read; the sitemap was used only for the names of member businesses). The chamber's Eventbrite organizer page, eventbrite.com/o/109326387961 (allowed by Eventbrite's robots.txt), was opened in a browser: 4 events in total over a year and 'Nothing planned right now', so 0 in the 30 days from 10 November. Its events are business networking (Timnath Connect, Caffeinate & Collaborate, Connections on Tap), regulars at most.

sources.name: Poudre Libraries events (Poudre River Public Library District)
sources.lastNote: robots.txt gives named search engines the site and every other agent 'Disallow: /'; and a keyword search for Timnath showed no events. 10 November 2026.
sources.notes: Found 10 November 2026. Timnath has no library branch; it is in the Poudre River Public Library District (Fort Collins branches), whose events run on LibraryCalendar at poudrelibraries.librarycalendar.com. Its robots.txt lists rules for named search crawlers and ends with 'User-agent: * / Disallow: /', so no feed was sought. One page, /events/list?keywords=Timnath, was fetched before that last rule was noticed: it listed no events. Search results explain why: the district's Storytime Express at Timnath Town Center ended when the Town did not renew the contract for 2025 (timnath.org notice of January 2025), and the newest Timnath items found were mobile-library ('Evie') visits in 2023. Nothing here for the guide unless the district resumes programs in town; check by hand a few times a year. Clearview Library District (Windsor, Severance) is the neighbouring district and is already in Windsor's registry; no Timnath program of theirs was found.

November 2026 to 5 December held three items: Youth Cooking - No Bake Desserts (7 Nov) and Youth Cooking - Festive Appetizers (21 Nov, 1 to 3 pm, Timnath Community Room), both classes, and a WildWing Community Garden plot entry (21 Nov), which is a rental. 0 worth a row in the 30 days from 10 November and 1 regular. sources.name: timnathbeerwerks.com
sources.notes: Seeded 2026-10-04 from the sources the content cites. Category guessed from the host name; type html until a feed is found. Checked 10 November 2026 for a feed. A Squarespace site: its events collection is /new-events, and /new-events?format=json&view=list answered 200 with 35 upcoming events, 33 of them in the next 30 days: 20 food-truck days and 13 others (Tuesday Night Poker, Wednesday Music Bingo, Thursday Timnath Pub Runners, Art on Tap with Painting with a Twist on 20 Nov, Thanksgiving special hours, Live Music: Christine Alice on 3 Dec, an adoption event and a paint-your-pet class on 5 Dec), every one located 'Timnath Beerwerks'. That JSON is Squarespace's own format, not The Events Calendar's REST format ingest reads, and Squarespace gives iCal only per event (?format=ical on the collection returns the HTML page), so there is no feed ingest can take today and the type stays html. A Squarespace-events reader in ingest would turn this into about 13 listings a month after excluding 'Food Truck' and 'Special Hours'. robots.txt allows /new-events (it disallows /api/, /config, /search). The Squarespace reader, 10 November 2026: the events collection, /new-events, is set to the calendar grid, which the page's script fills from /api/, so its HTML holds no events and the reader cannot read it under the site's robots.txt (which disallows /api/, ?view= and ?format=json). Not typed squarespace. Two ways on: the brewery switches the page to its list view, or the owner sets robots: subscribe and the feedUrl to https://timnathbeerwerks.com/new-events?view=list (untested, since that address was not fetched by the reader). The site's time zone setting is America/Kentucky/Monticello; the reader lists the clock the page shows, so that does not matter. Turned on 10 November 2026 on the owner's word ("Go 1 to 3"): typed squarespace with the list view, /new-events?view=list, as its feedUrl, and robots: subscribe, because the site's robots.txt disallows ?view= and the plain page is the calendar grid with no events in it. This is a wider use of subscribe than a published calendar feed: it is another view of the brewery's own page, read once a week, on the owner's call. Read that day by the reader: 35 items, 20 of them food-truck days, 3 poker nights, 3 music bingos, 2 Pub Runners, and Art on Tap (20 Nov), Live Music: Christine Alice (3 Dec), an adoption event and a paint-your-pet class (5 Dec). Food trucks, poker, bingo and the run club are left in as regulars, which the home tabs show only on a quiet day (DECISIONS.md, "Regulars fill a quiet day"); only the special-hours marker is excluded. The owner may prefer to exclude the trucks, as Mighty River's are. Food trucks excluded by title from 10 November 2026: asked whether to exclude them as Mighty River's are, the owner said yes. The trucks already on the guide by hand are not touched by this.

sources.name: Timnath Middle-High School calendar (Poudre School District)
sources.notes: Found and read 10 November 2026. The school's site (tmh.psdschools.org, Drupal) embeds a public Google Calendar, 'Timnath Middle-High'; its iCal address was fetched once: 2,492 VEVENTs back to December 2021, 68 with RRULE, 35 single items in the next 30 days. Nearly all of those are the school's own business: 'Even Day' / 'Odd Day' markers (18), college and military rep visits, scholarship nights in Fort Collins, incoming-grade nights. What a town guide would list is thin: TMHS Band Concerts (9 Dec, 6 pm), a Boys' Soccer Dine & Give at GQue BBQ (18 Nov) and a Girls' Golf fundraiser at Fuzzy's (19 Nov, in Fort Collins); about 1 to 3 a month. Most items carry no LOCATION, so a location filter would drop the concert; filter by title instead. Suggested title exclusions: '^(Even|Odd) Day$', 'Rep Visit', 'College', 'Scholarship', 'Fall Break', 'School not in session'. Games are not on this calendar (the district keeps schedules on ArbiterLive; the guide's sports come from MaxPreps). Timnath Elementary (tim.psdschools.org) and Bethke Elementary (bet.psdschools.org) embed Google Calendars of their own (psdschools.org_u2dd4ujbhv1hg6ja8esaffenlo@ and psdschools.org_j9skmsrat51kn5t2gmsq1sus10@group.calendar.google.com), not fetched. robots.txt: calendar.google.com disallows everything but its home page for every agent, so under 'honor' ingest will not read this; whether a school's public calendar link is a subscription is the editor's call. robots: subscribe from 10 November 2026, the owner's call: the host's robots.txt disallows the path, and this is the calendar the organization publishes for subscription; one weekly read is what a subscribed calendar does (DECISIONS.md, "The owner subscribes to the calendar feeds"). Exclusions widened 10 November 2026 after a dry run staged 53 items in 120 days: practices, weights, camps, tryouts, testing days, finals, parent meetings, student-only socials and recruiter visits are kept out, which leaves the concerts, the musical and the fundraisers. Filed as venue from 10 November 2026, with the school as the default venue, as the other high school calendars are: the school's own calendar speaks for its concerts and fundraisers, so they publish under the standing rules (the owner, "yes, step 2").

sources.name: Light of the Moon Theatre, Timnath Middle-High School (plays and musicals)
sources.defaultVenue: Timnath Middle-High School, 4700 E Prospect Rd
sources.notes: Found and read 10 November 2026. The school's theatre program, at Timnath Middle-High School, 4700 E Prospect Rd, Timnath; its site is linked from tmh.psdschools.org (Activities). A Google Sites site, no calendar and no feed. Fetched: /home, /productions, /productions/middle-school-musical and /buy-tickets. The 2026-2027 season, 'Armor, Angst & Aegean Sea', is three productions: a fall play (October 2026, past), the middle school musical Rock of Ages ('November/December 2026', described as family-friendly) and the high school musical (March 2027). The pages give months, not nights; the nights are on the ticket site, tmhs.booktix.com, which answered curl with a Cloudflare block (403, 'Sorry, you have been blocked') although its robots.txt disallows nothing, so the performance dates were not read and nothing was counted. Expect one run of about 3 to 4 nights inside 10 November to 10 December, each night worth a row once a person reads the dates from the ticket page in a browser. The school's Google Calendar (tmh-psdschools-org, confirmed) has staged band and orchestra concerts but no musical nights, so this is not a duplicate of it. robots.txt on sites.google.com disallows /feeds and /*/_/ only; these pages are allowed. Three runs a year; check by hand in October, November and February.

sources.name: Colorado Youth Outdoors (NoCo Winter Wonderland light show, Family Fishing Derby)
sources.defaultVenue: Colorado Youth Outdoors, 4927 E County Road 36, Fort Collins
sources.notes: Found and read 10 November 2026. The editor's call whether this belongs to Timnath: the campus is at 4927 E County Road 36, Fort Collins, CO 80528 (entrance on Kechter Rd just east of County Road 5), a Fort Collins postal address on Timnath's south-west edge, and it came up in a 3-mile search around Old Town Timnath on North Forty News's calendar. Fetched /events/ and /nocowinterwonderland/ (WordPress, no events plugin: /wp-json/tribe/events/v1/events is 404 and the page links no iCal). NoCo Winter Wonderland is a drive-through light show, 'Thanksgiving to New Year's Eve', $25 a vehicle, in its 7th year; North Forty News's calendar lists it nightly at 5 pm from 27 November, which is 14 nights inside 10 November to 10 December 2026, one listing with a run rather than 14 different dates. Tickets are on winterwonderland.ticketsauce.com (not fetched). The other public dates are fundraisers in 2027: The Maverick clay shoot at Sylvan Dale Ranch in Loveland (30 April to 1 May, not here), the Family Fishing Derby (19 June 2027, $5 a person, 'the one day of the year our ponds are open to the public') and The Camo Cup (29 June 2027). About 2 to 3 listings a year; a page for a person. robots.txt disallows nothing and asks for a 10-second crawl delay.

Each has its own theme, so each is worth a row. The season is over: 0 dated 10 November to 10 December 2026 and nothing for the holidays on the page. About 1 a month from May to October; read by hand each April when the new season is posted. robots.txt: 'Allow: /' with only ?lightbox= links disallowed.

sources.name: North Forty News local calendar (CitySpark)
sources.notes: Found and read 10 November 2026. North Forty News is the northern Larimer County paper that covers Timnath; its calendar (and NoCo Style magazine's, nocostyle.com/calendar) is a CitySpark portal that organizers and CitySpark's own collectors fill, so it is a place to find what others list, not an organizer. No iCal or RSS: the page is drawn by script from a POST to https://portal.cityspark.com/api/events/GetEvents/NorthForty (JSON in CitySpark's own shape, with a search word, a centre and a radius), which ingest cannot read, so the type is manual. That endpoint was read twice for 10 November to 10 December 2026. Searching 'Timnath' gave 11 items; within 3 miles of Old Town Timnath, 25. Worth a row: Santa at Mtn + Mane (15 Nov, 1 pm, Mtn + Mane Salon, 5451 E Harmony Rd Suite 109, Timnath, tickets on Eventbrite), new to the guide; the Holiday Home Tour at Harmony Club (12 to 14 Nov), which the guide has; and NoCo Winter Wonderland at Colorado Youth Outdoors (nightly from 27 Nov, 14 nights, proposed as its own source). Regulars: Timnath Beerwerks' Tuesday poker (5) and a coworking meetup at Pedro's Coffee (2). So about 1 to 3 new listings a month, read by hand: open the calendar, enter 'Timnath, CO' and a small radius. Exclusions if it is ever read by script: 'Poker', 'Coworking'. robots.txt: northfortynews.com disallows only /wp-admin/; portal.cityspark.com disallows only /test/ and /v2/.

sources.name: Eventbrite, events in Timnath
sources.notes: Proposed 10 November 2026, when the owner asked for a way to use Eventbrite. The place page is Eventbrite's search of the region around Timnath, not of the town: 49 pages of twenty. The reader (scripts/lib/feeds/eventbrite.ts) takes the first five pages, one every two seconds, and the location filter keeps what is in Timnath. Read that day: 100 events in five pages, 1 of them in town: PET PAINT BY NUMBER @Timnath Beerwerks w Love You Buddy SAT. DEC. 5 (2026-12-05, Timnath Beerwerks). Eventbrite lists every organizer's events, so this is filed as other and its items wait for a person; classes and workshops are most of what a small town shows. robots.txt at www.eventbrite.com allows the page for ordinary agents (it disallows its internal /api/v3/destination/ search, which the reader does not use). Eventbrite's terms of service restrict automated collection of its pages; confirming this source is the owner's decision with that in mind. The event search API was shut in 2020, and the API that remains lists only the token holder's own events. Confirmed 10 November 2026 on the owner's word ("for all towns as well use eventbrite"), told that Eventbrite's terms restrict automated collection and that robots.txt allows the page. Still filed as other: its items wait for a person. autoApprove from 10 November 2026, the owner's word ("auto publish all; having to manually do it would defeat the purpose of the town network setup"): its items publish under the standing rules, and one that may be an event already on the guide at that hour still waits. The title exclusions were widened the same day to what the guide never lists: professional trainings and association socials, partisan events, sales demonstrations, clinics' own workshops, app-run scavenger hunts and events in a private home.
